summary.text: Adam Vance is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates representing District 35, which covers Wyoming County.
He is vice chair of the Health Care Regulation committee and also sits on Education, Health and Human Resources, and Higher Education.

paragraphs.text: Vance was born in Beckley, West Virginia, and his page lists his education as Baileysville High School, class of 2000, and Western Governors University.
His occupation is listed as underground coal miner; he is married to Patti Vance and has five children.
His interim committee assignments are the Committee on Flooding, Education, and Health.
His 2026 sponsored legislation includes a joint resolution to set term limits for the West Virginia Legislature.
